_readme: Source data for the `reviews` collection. Import: node seed/reviews.mjs --local | --remote
RULES: text is VERBATIM from the source (typos and double spaces included). Never paraphrase or invent a review.
review_date is YYYY-MM, or YYYY when the source only gives 'N years ago' (Google). Google dates are approximate.
Collected 2026-09-25: Google (Maps, 19 with text), Realtor.com (20 reviews + 18 recommendations, via Firecrawl),
Zillow (42, via Firecrawl). One entry per unique text - Google > Realtor.com (real names) > Zillow.
rating null = Realtor.com 'recommendation' (no stars given by the client); rendered without stars.
Yelp NOT included: Firecrawl refuses yelp.com and Yelp blocks automated browsers.
hidden:true = imported but not shown. featured:true = shown first in the home page carousel.
Re-importing updates text/rating/date/links but NEVER overwrites Featured/Hidden once a review exists in the DB.

reviews.name: Dave Winter
reviews.body: Grant and team rocks!

reviews.name: Britt Johnson
reviews.body: Grant has a deep understanding of the Incline market, a great personality, and worked hard to find the right place.  Was there al the way through closing and past.

reviews.name: Veronica Cisneros
reviews.body: Grant is the real deal. He sold our home fast, got us the highest price ever recorded for a 2-bedroom unit in Incline Manor, and made the entire process feel completely manageable. He held our hand without making us feel like we needed it, every step was clear, every question was answered, and we never felt left in the dark. His team is sharp, his communication is on point, and his straightforward approach made the whole experience one we'd do again without hesitation. If you want someone who actually knows what they're doing and treats your sale like it matters, Grant is your guy. We'll be back.

reviews.name: Richard Burkette
reviews.body: I had a very positive experience working with Grant Meyer. He was patient, easy to communicate with, and always willing to go the extra mile to help. His knowledge and professionalism really stood out, and I felt confident having him guide me through the process. I would gladly work with Grant again and would recommend him to anyone needing a great agent.

reviews.name: Richard Burkette
reviews.body: Grant Meyer was outstanding to work with from start to finish. He was knowledgeable, responsive, and always made me feel like I had someone in my corner throughout the entire process. He took the time to answer questions, explain details clearly, and made everything feel much less stressful than it could have been. I really appreciated his professionalism, honesty, and attention to detail. I would highly recommend Grant to anyone looking for a realtor who genuinely cares and works hard for his clients.

reviews.name: Richard Burkette
reviews.body: Grant Meyer was great to work with. He was professional, responsive, and made the entire process smooth and easy to navigate. I appreciated his communication, market knowledge, and the way he always kept things moving. I would definitely recommend him to anyone looking for a reliable and hardworking realtor.

reviews.name: Jeff Crowe
reviews.body: We have now had the pleasure of working with Grant on 3 different transactions over the span of a decade, and in each case we presented him with some unusual challenges. He met them all, and always with a smile. We couldn't be happier with his representation and we'll definitely use him again if needed. Nobody knows the local market better.

reviews.name: Leslie Suh
reviews.body: Grant’s representation was instrumental in the purchase of our home in Incline Village. He and Zoe handled every aspect of the purchase making the process as easy as possible for us and were a pleasure to work with.

reviews.name: Nancy P
reviews.body: My husband and I are so thankful that we chose Grant Meyer to be our realtor when we decided to sell our 3-bedroom condo, which was situated in a difficult market, with several other similar condos that had been listed for sale for many months.  Grant’s professional expertise made it possible for us to sell our condo at a fair price in a timely manner.  We are convinced that it was only due to his creative problem-solving, local experience and superior negotiating skill that our condo became the only 3-bedroom condo sold in our HOA in almost two years.  Grant exceeded our expectations and we highly recommend him.

reviews.name: Andreea Tamas
reviews.body: I have had an amazing working with Grant and Zoe (his assistant). They were very professional, responsive and fun to work with. My house sold very fast at an amazing price and I am very grateful for having the opportunity to work with them. I highly recommend Grant as your agent, he will take good care of you. Thank you Grant and Zoe for your service.

reviews.name: Moran Shoham
reviews.body:
Grant is an absolute standout in the real estate world! From start to finish, his professionalism, personable approach, and deep knowledge of the market made the process smooth and stress-free. 
His superior customer service truly sets him apart.
With his extensive local experience, he guided us through every step, anticipating challenges before they arose and offering thoughtful solutions. 
I’m beyond grateful for his dedication and care, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend him to anyone looking for a top-tier real estate professional.

reviews.name: Flora Zagruzny
reviews.body: Grant helped me find my perfect home, and he and his colleague Zoe guided me through the whole process (and after!). They really, really know Incline Village and are super passionate about serving their clients. They went above and beyond. Would 100% recommend!

reviews.name: Moran Shoham
reviews.body: We just sold our house with Grant. He provided superior customer service, personal and attentive, and extremely professional. there is no doubt in my mind that we will work with him in the future should we need to buy or sell our house again.

reviews.name: Captain Myles
reviews.body:
We have used several excellent realtors over the years and Grant is the best! We feel so fortunate that we used Grant as our agent in our purchase!
Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Lowell Matthews
reviews.body: Through recommendations from a trusted friend, we chose Grant to represent us in selling our Incline Village house.  The choice was perfect.  We sold the house in less than a week thanks to Grant’s talent and guidance.  His superb local knowledge of the Incline market helped guide us to an appropriate final price with no regrets.  Grant was patient, professional and a good listener.  He gave excellent advice backed up with key insights into the market dynamics as they stood at the time. He was helpful at all stages of the selling process, from locating staging and prep vendors to the final escrow process.  Always available and super responsive.  100% recommend.

reviews.name: A Veit
reviews.body: We chose Grant as our real estate agent after speaking with numerous agents in the area and couldn’t have been happier with our experience. Grant is extremely professional, a good listener, and very experienced in the market given his long tenure in the area. During the purchasing process he was always available, on top of new houses that came on the market, and willing to go the extra mile. In addition to selecting properties to tour based our needs, he helped us with a vision of what our property can become. Even after we purchased our home, he was there with local trade contacts and we still use him as a resource months after our transaction. We highly recommend Grant Meyer.

reviews.name: Kevin Stephano
reviews.body: I appreciated Grant's local knowledge of Incline Village and being able to field questions that were relevant to the area.  It was clear he knew the properties and neighborhoods around the area very well and was able to give me knowledge of the place I bought prior to it officially entering the market.  I was looking for a house that was not as common being a smaller home with a lake view and was turn-key which made its comps a little more difficult.  I appreciated the effort he gave in explaining the market of the house and showing me a best guess effort at the comps.

reviews.name: Scott Bowie
reviews.body: Stop your search, Grant is the realtor you're looking for.  I have worked with Grant on numerous transactions with several angles over the years: as buyer (multiple times), as seller (multiple times), in dual agency situations, buying off-market, negotiating seller financing, in a 1031 exchange, on both primary residences and investment properties, and even resolving an utterly intractable big bank lender.  Grant knows how to navigate every situation expertly - which is both cause and effect of being the highest-grossing agent in the entire state of Nevada last year.  By now you have (or you will soon) read all kinds of praise of Grant all over the internet, including his first review on Zillow that I wrote in 2016. I know of no higher validation of Grant's attitude, competence, and infectious energy than repeatedly giving him my business over the past decade.

reviews.name: Jane Barnhart
reviews.body: My sale would probably not have gone through if it were anyone else other than Grant who worked with me! He is just THE BEST!!!! There were LOTS of issues and we overcame them!!! Jane Barnhart

reviews.name: Nate H
reviews.body: Grant was fantastic to work with.  Professional, knowledgeable and caring.   Grant has the expertise and keen insight on the local market and was able to give us the best advice and guidance to help us find the perfect fit for our family.

reviews.name: nho1000
reviews.body: Grant was awesome to work with.  He is extremely knowledgeable and compassionate.   A true professional and tremendously caring.  Fantastic experience. I would enthusiastic recommend Grant without reservation.  Thank you, Grant.

reviews.name: Julian
reviews.body: Grant provided very informative and accurate details in assisting with my sale, and excellent service at all times.

reviews.name: Jackie Schafer
reviews.body: This is the second time we’ve had the pleasure of working with Grant to purchase a property in Incline Village. His extensive knowledge and network in the area are unparalleled, which makes him an expert at navigating the complex market. He is responsive, informed, and treats his clients like friends. We have bought and sold many properties in the last 35 years, working with agents all over the country—we can attest that Grant is one of the best. If you’re looking to buy or sell a home in Incline Village, you won’t find a better agent to represent you. We’re grateful to have his expertise and dedication to find our new home!

reviews.name: carlorivera182
reviews.body: We’ve worked with Grant on a couple deals both as buyers and sellers. Grant delivered exceptional insight and timing when listing our home. We requested an agent present listing because a lot of our personal effects where still at the property and we felt more comfortable having him supervise our showings. He did so with pleasure and ensured our home stayed in great shape through the sale process. Grant is a trusted consultant and a great professional.

reviews.name: Nate Ho
reviews.body: Grant is awesome and fantastic to work with.  He is extremely knowledgeable and compassionate.  He cares about clients and  invested in the community that he serves.  We could not say enough good things about his professionalism.  It was a pleasure and joy to have him help us find the perfect home.

reviews.name: S Mueller
reviews.body: Grant Meyer helped us sell our condo in record time.  I was amazed by how many showings we had in a short time.  Grant's professionalism helped us through a process that we were unfamiliar with, getting us a great deal and a successful close.

reviews.name: Julian Willmore
reviews.body: Grant provided all the information needed and was always available to answer questions, great service from a great operator.

reviews.name: Nick Schafer
reviews.body: Grant is the best in the area! Pleasure to work with.

reviews.name: Nancy White
reviews.body: We used Grant to purchase our home in Incline Village.  His extensive local knowledge of the Tahoe region helped us determine that this was the right move for us.  Grant is extremely professional and was able to walk through a property, either in person with us or remotely via FaceTime, and point out the pros and cons of any given listing.  He listened to our needs/wants when we first met and was able to tell us why a property would or would not work.  We have bought and sold many properties in the last 35 years and worked with agents all over the country.  Grant was the single best agent we have ever used.  I highly recommend him for either listing your home or to help you purchase a home!

reviews.name: Jerry Unger
reviews.body: I hadn't needed a real estate agent in over 35 years. Grant was recommended to me by two longtime residents of Incline Village. He guided me through all the details involved in selling my property and was great in every way.

reviews.name: Gabe P
reviews.body: Grant is the expert and advocate you need for buying a home in Incline Village. We were first time buyers in Lake Tahoe and found Grant through a friend's recommendation. Grant seems to always be available, has deep knowledge of the area and homes he shows, is professional, and such an easy going person. And importantly he is truthworthy; while showcasing the strengths of each property, he is also upfront about issues/downsides. You cannot go wrong with Grant by your side!

reviews.name: Emily
reviews.body: This is the third time we have had the pleasure of working with Grant on the sale/purchase of a home, and he never fails to produce incredible results! We were moving back to the area after a couple of years away and knew we needed him by our side to navigate the incredibly complex real estate market in Incline. We could not be more pleased that he was able to find us our forever home and negotiate a tremendous deal off the original purchase price! Grant is truly the BEST real estate agent in Incline Village and knows the area and market better than anyone else. If you are looking to buy or sell in Incline, he is the only person I would ever recommend. He incredibly diligent, quick to respond, and has tremendously sound advice. We would trust him with the purchase or sale of a home 100 times over, and we are proud to not only call him our wonderful agent, but also an incredible friend.

reviews.name: Dru
reviews.body: Having been let down many times by the current market and other realtors, we were beyond lucky to work with Grant to purchase of our first home. He is THE Incline Village expert, treats his clients like family, and crazy fast and responsive. The master negotiator and advice giver, we cannot recommend Grant enough. Thank you Grant for finding us our dream home!!

reviews.name: ramin786
reviews.body: Buying a home in an unknown market always comes with a level of uncertainty and stress - but Grant made the process very easy and comfortable.  He extremely responsive, knowledgeable, forthcoming and professional.  Also, he ranks as one of the hardest working agents I've every worked with.  I highly recommend him.

reviews.name: Jessica
reviews.body: I met Grant at a time when I was ready to give up on my Tahoe dreams. After staying with a friend in Incline Village, I found Grant. His local knowledge and responsiveness helped me restart my search. Grant always made me feel he was in my corner and willing to go to bat for me. While I don’t like intruding on anyone’s personal time, Grant was always responsive whether I was calling at 9am or 9pm and he knows everyone. If you need a local HVAC or roofer or contractor or radon inspector, he got someone. His network is broad. I would trust Grant again in a heart beat.

reviews.name: Christine Yen
reviews.body:
Grant is the local North Tahoe agent you've been looking for. He leads with his intimate knowledge of the area, follows through with great tours where he's able to highlight good *and* not-so-good things he knows you'll care about, and wraps it all up with a smooth close.

We're looking forward to tapping into his sizable network for any work we need done in the future. We had a great experience overall—thanks, Grant!

reviews.name: Robert
reviews.body: Grant is a hard worker. He communicates well & has an exellent breadth  of knowledge and experience for Incline Village. He makes the process fun!

reviews.name: k8teh00p
reviews.body: Grant really goes Above and Beyond for his clients. I am incredibly impressed with his work ethic.  He is always available and very knowledgeable. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: AlexWitt1
reviews.body: Grant represented us as a buyer. He always put our interests first and demonstrated exceptional professionalism and local knowledge/insights. Highly recommend Grant to anyone looking to buy/sell in Incline Village, NV.

reviews.name: WayneStyskel
reviews.body: Set a record sale amount.  Closed fast.  All of his recommendations were correct. Can't think of one thing that didn't go smooth and fast.  Don't be a big dummy.  Call Grant.

reviews.name: carlorivera182
reviews.body: Grant helped us find the PERFECT Tahoe property. It took well over a year and he never lost his patience and was willing and able to take a shot on every property we tried to bid on. An absolute pleasure to deal with, a trusted consultant, and a great friend. In a tough market we found that his relationships with other agents helped us get engaged on properties that otherwise we wouldn't have seen.

reviews.name: Adam
reviews.body: My wife and I feel so fortunate that we were introduced to Grant. He worked with us for almost a year as we looked to buy our first home and exhibited nothing but knowledge, patience, and understanding. We never felt pressured by Grant during any showing and he took the time to find out what we were looking for so that he could help guide our decision. In the end, we bought a home that we had initially overlooked that Grant then pointed out to us and we are so happy with our decision. Thanks Grant!!

reviews.name: Keith
reviews.body: Grant was excellent to work with. He was extremely responisve and worked tirelessly to find the right property for us. He goes above and beyond to make sure his clients are completely satisfied. I highly recommend contacting Grant for Ll of your real estate needs.

reviews.name: tmadam
reviews.body:
I could not have been any more lucky than to work with Grant.  My situation was a foreign event for me with selling a property in another state and relocating to Nevada, all through digital means.  Grant was always in communication with me, kept me updated and assured me he would do everything to help me with the logistical challenge.
I highly recommend Grant for any of your real estate interests in the Tahoe area.  Thanks so much, Grant!

reviews.name: Nick Schafer
reviews.body: Grant was a excellent resource for us - he was readily available and got us into our home as quick as can be! Thrilled to have his help and grateful for the experience!

reviews.name: David
reviews.body: Grant has helped us with 2 home sales and 1 purchase and in every transaction we've been very pleased with the outcome.  He offers insight, creativity, energy, diligence and thoughtfulness and recommend him highly.

reviews.name: Alves
reviews.body:
A+++ Rating
Answered every call immediately , was at EVERY showing, intelligence and knowledge of the market was amazing, worked harder than I could have even asked him to.
Highly recommended !

reviews.name: Joel W Hay
reviews.body: Grant is the consumate real estate agent.  Having grown up in a home construction family he understands real estate value better than anyone I know.  He knows homes from the foundation up and the structural beams out.  He has helped me enormously not only in the many houses he helped me buy but also in the many houses he helped me avoid.

reviews.name: gongwiththenguyen
reviews.body: Amazing experience working with grant - there's nothing like having an experienced professional who is very familiar with the area to help navigate the complexities of a dynamic real estate market and all the nuances that go into purchasing a new home.  If you are trying to buy real estate in Incline Village, don't hesitate to contact Grant - we looked at several properties and our offers denied 3-4 times, but Grant landed the PERFECT home that literally met every single one of our criteria without us having to sacrifice a single thing, all within a reasonable budget.  We are so happy with our new home and highly recommend others to reach out to Grant even if you are only just starting your search!

reviews.name: JoelHay
reviews.body: Grant is the consumate real estate agent.  He grew up in a home construction family and understands every building from the foundation up and the structural beams out.  He knows value better than anyone I've met in the real estate business.  He has helped me buy (and just as importantly NOT buy) several properties in the Reno/Tahoe area.  I value his advice and friendship enormously.

reviews.name: Jim Alves
reviews.body: Grant was Amazing ! He treated our home like his own, personally showed up for EVERY showing. His knowledge and education of the market and what buyers are looking for was unbelievable, we closed on the highest note. Can't give Grant enough praise !

reviews.name: Nick H.
reviews.body: Grant is amazing! He has truly made our wildest dreams come true, most recently with a spectacular sale in Mill Creek that closed in early 2021. We started working with Grant in 2016 when he helped us buy a house and sell another in Incline Village. Grant stays on top of every part of the buying/selling process, even stepping in to help the other agent. Grant has literally made us millions via his expertise, negotiating skills and charm. Can't recommend enough!

reviews.name: chuckmeyerconstruction
reviews.body:
Grant did an excellent job, finding us a buyer and negotiating top dollar for our property.  I highly recommend him for finding a home or selling your current home.
He is very knowledgeable about there area.

reviews.name: mail4moores
reviews.body: Grant Meyer is incredibly responsive, knowledgeable, helpful and detail oriented - he made our Incline condo purchase quick, easy and stress-free!  We will definitely use him again to buy or sell a home/condo!!!

reviews.name: epeltier82
reviews.body: This is the second time that we have worked with Grant and will not be the last! Our experience selling our home was stressful with the first buyers cancelling and some unforeseen challenges with the second buyers. Grant was able to navigate all of the issues and get us to the finish line. We could not be more thrilled with the outcome and return we received on our investment. We highly recommend using Grant for his attention to detail, quick action, negotiation skills, and vast knowledge of the Incline Village real estate market.

reviews.name: Mark Corrallo
reviews.body: Grant is the best real estate agent in Incline Village.  Period.

reviews.name: Gretchen Sawyer
reviews.body: We have purchased and sold no less than a dozen homes in the Reno Tahoe area and no one has stewarded us through the process as well as Grant has done. He’s an excellent advisor as well as real estate agent. He flat takes care of business in an efficient and speedy way. His knowledge of the law assists him in providing excellent guidance throughout the entire process.

reviews.name: Kate Schweiss
reviews.body: We really enjoyed working with Grant! He worked tirelessly to achieve our goals as both sellers and buyers, and we never doubted that he had our best interests in mind. He has a can-do positive outlook that made the whole process as painless as possible. We definitely recommend working with him!

reviews.name: Jeff Crowe
reviews.body: Grant wasn’t a friend when we first decided to engage him as our Realtor, but he is now. Does that make it a conflict of interest for me to give him a glowing review? I mean, his excellent work on our behalf, through multiple transactions in both the sell and the buy side, provided the context in which we got to know each other enough to connect. I’m happy to call him a friend and would recommend him without hesitation.

reviews.name: bobtait485
reviews.body:
Grant is very thorough in assessing the local market and establishing a realistic list price for our house.
He is personable, efficient and energetic.
I would be happy to recommend him to anyone coming into, or moving from, the Incline Village market.

reviews.name: Matthew Rautio
reviews.body: Grant receives my highest recommendation for any potential homeowners in the area! We met with him multiple times before closing on our home and he was always well prepared and provided multiple options that were available during a time when the market was slower (even options that were expected to come on the market in the future). He took the time to get to know us and what we would be happy with. When it came down to a decision between 3-4 places, he gave us his recommendation and it ended up being better than we expected! We will certainly be loyal to him for any of our future real estate purchases.

reviews.name: Darya
reviews.body:
Grant went above and beyond throughout the whole house buying process! As a first time house buyer, Grant's extensive knowledge of the area, his honesty and his patience made me extremely comfortable as a newbie and super excited to move to Incline Village. Not to mention, he's just a great guy to be around!

He always responded promptly and paid close attention to our likes and dislikes as we house hunted together and went out of his way to cater to them.

I truly can't imagine a better house-buying experience.

Thank you for everything, Grant!

reviews.name: Mei Carpenter
reviews.body:
I strongly recommend anyone to have Grant as their real estate agent. 
I was not a good client. I was on the fence of selling my Lake Tahoe house for a long time. I even signed a contract and canceled with Grant then signed him up again three months later. 
Every step along the way, Grant was always patient and professional with me. At the end, we sold the house at the price he analyzed initially. I am impressed by his local knowledge, local resources and tenacious spirit to sell the house at the best price for his client. He never twisted my arms to accept offers that was not right for me. 

I am so blessed that I chose grant as my agent to sell my Lake Tahoe house. It made me want to be a nicer person and do more great things. I think Grant was God send for rewarding my good deeds.

reviews.name: epeltier4
reviews.body: As a first-time homebuyer, I had the feelings of uncertainty and nervousness when I decided to buy a home in Incline Village. Grant immediately put all my nerves to ease and made the process completely enjoyable! I found an awesome home with his help, he negotiated a great deal, and I never once worried about anything related to contracts, inspections, or appraisals. He took care of it all and was so on top of things! First-time homebuyer or twenty-time homebuyer, I would definitely recommend Grant!

reviews.name: Clyde MD
reviews.body:
Grant Meyer exceeded all of our expectations in regards to both house hunting as well as navigating the offer/inspections/escrow portions of the process. He never failed to promptly respond to a call, text or email. While I was in town for 1 day with literally only 2 hours free, I was hoping to see a couple of houses that were at the top of our list. He managed to arrange an amazingly organized tour of at least 8 properties, one of which had only been on the market for a few hours. He clearly has great relationships with other realtors which allowed him to get us in to so many places on very short notice, many of which needed the seller’s agent to be present as well. The properties he identified included one which was perfect for our family, and we placed an offer that day. In inspecting the property, unexpected things came up and he had a contact for all of our needs. He arranged for them to come out immediately for estimates and even pulled strings for the glass company that was booking 2 weeks out on estimates and had them out there in 2 days. 
We felt that his recommendations were always great and he saved us more money during the negotiations than we ever would have expected. We completed our signing of closing documents from another time zone, and when we identified a significant error in the paper work (from the mortgage company) that was extremely time sensitive, we tried to contact our title company and lender for guidance, not surprisingly with no answer at 4:30 AM pacific time, but guess who did answer and was more than willing to help....Grant! We can’t wait to move into our beautiful new home (which he is still helping us coordinate contractors, painters, etc), and none of it would have happened without the outstanding guidance and expert help from Grant Meyer, Incline’s Beat Realtor, hands down!

reviews.name: HeartsandPawsinIV
reviews.body: Grant was on top of the details and had great advice to provide. He knows the Tahoe market well and especially Incline Village. When there were areas where we had differing opinions, Grant listened to our concerns and was open to new ideas. He had a great can-do attitude without ever being pushy. We are happy with the outcome of our home sale and would recommend Grant highly.

reviews.name: Bart Colombini
reviews.body: Very happy I was randomly looking at properties a couple of years ago and stumbled upon one of Grant’s listings. That particular deal didn’t work out, but he kept in touch with me and I think we closed on one that will be good for me for years to come. Very nice, responsive and he has been helping me even after closing the property. All around 5 stars.

reviews.name: Nick Harris
reviews.body: Grant helped us sell our first house up in Tyrolian Village in record time (literally less than a month after listing and we did not price low!), and helped us get a great deal on the house we're currently in. Grant has become a close friend and we are absolutely thrilled to have him as our realtor.

reviews.name: nevadausc
reviews.body: If you are looking to buy or sale a home in Incline Village, NV you have to go with Grant Meyer. He grew up in this town and he knows everything about the local market. Honestly, I can not thank him enough for the house he got for me. Do yourself a favor and give Grant a call, you will not regret it.

reviews.name: cassie40
reviews.body: Grant helped us find the ideal property to fit within our budget and desired specifications. He went above and beyond to make the entire process smooth and easy for us. He helped us locate our new home, sell our old house, and navigate all the complications involved in that process. Our house sold within a couple days! Our experience with him was great and I would definitely recommend him to anyone looking to buy and/or sell a home.

reviews.name: stefayniejarosz
reviews.body: My husband & I had a great experience with Grant.  We dropped into Incline Village unannounced, and Grant stepped in to help us right away.  He took the time to show us several properties at our convenience.  He also helped us through the offer process, and was patient with our mistakes.  After our sale went through, he was always available for questions, and helped us deal with a post-sale issue.  We definitely recommend Grant.

reviews.name: johnmpeltier
reviews.body: This is my second real estate transaction with Grant and I came back to him for good reason. He took a tough property to sell and got it sold in no time.  He worked around the clock in a professional, enthusiastic manner to close quickly and never left any room for doubt regarding his abilities. I'm looking forward to working with Grant a third time in the near future.

reviews.name: keithrudd2003
reviews.body: Grant is professional and very knowledgeable. He works extremely hard for his clients. Grant went out of his way to make sure we found the right property.  During the entire process he made sure we were well informed and made sure that everything went well.  I highly recommend him for all of your real estate needs.

reviews.name: Scott Bowie
reviews.body: Grant is an outstanding realtor (and I've used many over the years).  He responds within the hour and worked behind the scenes to acquire whatever info I wanted about the property I was buying.  In addition to buying my home with Grant last year, this year we bought an investment property with Grant as well -- another fantastic, flawless execution including seller financing that Grant helped negotiate.  Grant works really hard and is super proactive (which if you know real estate agents in Incline Village, isn't all that common) and is an incredibly positive, energizing person to be around.  When I want to buy or sell in the future, he's the first person I will be calling.
